verdict.rationale: Poly documents its own search inside file contents, using natural language down to the page or paragraph. It also offers folder-scoped search via "Search within...", which covers path filtering, and terminal search with `poly search`. Tags exist and sync with Finder, but no evidence shows search can filter by tags or properties. Pinning files for offline access and an offline sync queue are adjacent features, not offline search. Missing for 10: tag filters in search, property/metadata filters, documented offline search, evidence of instant/literal full-text matching, independent corroboration.
